summary: A trainee asks {board} to weigh a patient's housing costs when setting the renewal guideline.
realLife: A Bronx medical student opposing an increase in 2025 described a patient who skipped insulin to afford rent. The board published the account as testimony.
gates: The case record identifies the submitted testimony, speaker's role and privacy-safe account.
